author: Thoughty2
description:
If you’ve ever wondered why anyone would want to rage against the machine, then look no further than 20th-century Tennessee.

Political machines were powerful networks that controlled votes, jobs, and influence. Behind the scenes, local bosses acted as the puppet masters, controlling local communities and ensuring they always had a group of willing  (or unwilling!) cronies whose entire existence depended on staying on the right side of the machine.
title: Inside Tennessee’s Political Machine
